_how: Each measure links to the Daily Californian article that describes it: source is the link, story its headline, shown under “About the measure.” Measure Z and Props. 40-42 have their own articles; the other Berkeley measures and RTM link to the Oct. 29, 2026 roundup “Berkeley voters to decide on 8 measures,” and the other propositions to the Oct. 29 state propositions guide. short is a one-line label written by the desk (the broadcast uses it too); propositions without one show the Secretary of State's ballot label. Keys: "Measure V" (no "Bond", no " - City of ...") or "Prop 40".
